channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Brandon town leaders are eyeing a two percent tax increase for the next budget. Town employees could see raises up to five percent, while police get a three percent plus two percent step raise. Rising costs for healthcare and fuel are major budget drivers.

The DEC and Adirondack Park Agency are seeking public input on upgrades to Rogers Rock Campground on Lake George. Proposed improvements include water and sewer system upgrades and land reclassification to protect wildlife. Comments are accepted through December twenty-first.

Killington and AFSCME Local one thousand two hundred one have reached a tentative first contract agreement. It covers the town’s non-supervisory employees and awaits ratification and approval. Talks with the police union are also moving forward positively.

Vermont's Housing Improvement Program has funded nearly twelve hundred affordable rental units since twenty twenty. Most landlords plan to keep rents affordable after their commitments end. The program supports vulnerable Vermonters and was made permanent this year.
